description: End-of-day prices for one US-listed ticker (stocks, ETFs, funds; delisted too) from 1962, plan permitting. PAID PLANS ONLY. One call = one ticker. Prices are USD; a ticker listed only abroad answers 'Not covered' with no prices. Row: date, close (as traded), adj_close (split+dividend adjusted), div_cash, split_factor. Max 5,000 rows per call: without since, the NEWEST 5,000 and prev_until; with since, the 5,000 from it and next_since. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_daily_prices Close Prices from Tiingo.com.

frequency.description: Default daily. weekly/monthly: last bar of each.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on date. Default: plan start. Next page: next_since.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on date. Default: latest. Page before: prev_until.

name: get_daily_prices
